verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no published, current processing-time information for any TWC transaction type, such as a processing-times page or stated turnaround windows. The only timing-related statement is that liable registrants immediately receive a tax account number. That is a static description of one registration outcome, not a published current processing time, so it is adjacent at most.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
